name: text-field
title: Text Field
description: A single-line text input with label, help text, validation and optional prefix/suffix, plus the field primitives other inputs compose.

examples.name: text-field-states
examples.title: States
examples.description: Default, required with description, invalid and disabled.

examples.name: text-field-prefix
examples.title: Prefix and suffix
examples.description: Currency, units or icons inside the input box.

examples.name: text-field-validation
examples.title: Validation
examples.description: Native required checks plus a validate() function, shown after submit.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, linked to the control. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown with an icon when invalid. Defaults to the browser or validate() message.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Example value. Not a substitute for a label.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the input, inside the box (text in text.subtle, or an icon).

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content after the input, inside the box (a unit, icon or small button).

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Marks the field required (native required + a decorative asterisk on the label).

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Forces the invalid state (aria-invalid, danger border, error message).

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation; return an error message to show.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Adds a decorative (aria-hidden) asterisk; the control carries the required state.

props.name: children
props.description: Help text. Renders React Aria's Text with slot="description".

props.name: children
props.description: Error text with an alert icon; renders nothing while the field is valid.

props.name: className
props.description: The bordered input. Inside a FieldGroup it becomes bare and the group draws the box.

props.name: children
props.description: Input plus adornments. Draws the box, hover/invalid/disabled states and the focus ring; a click on it focuses the input.

notes: Label, description and error message are linked to the input with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby.
Errors show an icon and text, never colour alone.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden: the input is announced as required through the native required attribute.
Text inputs show the focus ring whenever focused, as browsers do for text inputs.

do: Always give a visible label; put format hints in description.
Use the right type and inputMode so mobile keyboards match the data.
Validate on submit and explain how to fix the error.
dont: Don't use the placeholder as the label.
Don't show an error before the person has had a chance to type.
